title: Russian Guided Bombs Strike Izium, Kharkiv Region, Damaging 20 Homes
detail: Russian forces struck residential areas of Izium in Kharkiv Oblast with three guided aerial bombs around 04:05 on August 23, wounding at least two people (Ukrinform later put the toll at four injured) and damaging roughly 20 houses, vehicles, and power lines. One bomb hit the northern part of the city, damaging about 10 houses; two further strikes hit the Verkhnie Selyshche neighborhood, sparking an outbuilding fire and damaging another 10 houses. It was the latest in a string of guided-bomb strikes on Izium through August, following an August 16 attack that injured five.

title: Jet-Powered Russian Drone Strikes Residential Kharkiv, Injuring Eight
detail: A Russian jet-powered 'Shahed' drone struck a residential area of Kharkiv's Osnovianskyi district in the early hours of August 23, injuring eight people — five women aged 23 to 74, two men aged 28 and 38, and a 15-year-old boy who suffered an acute stress reaction. The strike sparked fires across two private houses and an outbuilding, burning roughly 250 square meters; nearby homes and a vehicle were also damaged. Emergency services extinguished the blaze.

title: Ukrainian Drones Reportedly Strike Ozon Logistics Center in Russia's Orenburg, 1,000km from Border
detail: Ukrainian forces reportedly struck an Ozon logistics center in Orenburg, southwestern Russia, roughly 1,000km from the Russia-Ukraine border, overnight on August 23 — the second reported strike on Ozon facilities in 24 hours after the August 22 attack on the retailer's Samara region warehouse. Social media video showed smoke rising from the warehouse; no casualties were reported and the full extent of the damage was unclear. Ukraine's Defense Ministry said after the prior day's strike that 'systematic strikes on storage centers for dual-use goods are making it more difficult for the enemy to operate.' Ukraine's military had not officially confirmed the Orenburg strike at time of reporting.
